entries.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
entries.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

entries.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

entries.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
entries.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

entries.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
entries.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

entries.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
entries.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

entries.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
entries.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

entries.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
entries.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

entries.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
entries.summary: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

entries.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
entries.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

entries.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
entries.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
